Continuous 
Furnace 
For bars with diameters of 8" (203 mm) or less, continuous furnace heat treatment is an 
acceptable alternative to conventional batch-type heat treatment.

Tempering Furnace 
Min time 
5 minutes (Note) 
Air cool or faster to room temperature 

The bar travels through several different temperature zones which allows the bar to heat to 
an austenitic state. 

Prior to entering the tempering furnace, the bar is spray quenched. Max water temperature 
at start of quench is 100F(38C). 

The tempering furnace zone temps are then selected to produce the required tempering 
effect. 

The length of the furnace and travel speed determined the time spent in the austenitizing and 
tempering furnace and the bar diameter affects the travel speed. 

To attain the required mechanical properties and microstructure, the time in each furnace 
should produce the same mechanical properties as a conventional quench-and-temper heat 
treatment.
